sections.title: Approve a launch plan in *3 steps*
sections.vo: Here is how to approve a launch plan in three quick steps.

sections.title: Open the plan
sections.vo: First, open the launch plan from your projects list.

sections.title: Run the checklist
sections.body: Tick what is done; the rest stays visible.
sections.vo: Next, run the review checklist. Anything unfinished stays highlighted.

sections.title: Approve
sections.body: One click notifies the whole team.
sections.vo: Finally, press approve. Everyone on the plan is notified.

sections.title: Before vs after
sections.vo: No more status meetings, and no more lost feedback.

sections.title: You're ready
